title: Wine and So Much More!
text: We have visited wine regions around the world with many guides.  I can tell you that Felciano is the best guide we have ever had and the Penedes wine region cannot be missed.  Felciano not only introduced us to three great wineries and some fantastic wines, but he also told us about the history of Catalonia and its people.  He also gave us great recommendations for the rest of our trip.  We feel as if we now have a true friend in Barcelona.  Merci, Feliciano!
author: John_H

title: Beautiful day
text: A beautiful day visiting 3 wineries. Feliciano was an incredible guide.  Each winery was special and lunch was delicious   Highly recommend

title: Best wine tour ever
text: Very impressed with this tour. Our tour guide was Feliciano and from the second we met up with him he was absolutely phenomenal. He is extremely friendly and knowledgeable about the city of Barcelona and the wines all over the region. He gave us a lot of useful information about the area and places to have some good food and drinks. Feliciano was even so sweet he offered to take multiple photos of us for our memory.
